facts.text: Rosewood Bangkok is a 30-storey vertical tower whose architecture is inspired by the wai, the Thai gesture of greeting.
facts.excerpt: A 30-storey, vertical architectural marvel inspired by the ‘wai,’ the famous Thai gesture of greeting.

facts.text: Rosewood Bangkok has four dining venues: Thai, Chinese, farm-to-table and a vinyl speakeasy.
facts.excerpt: Rosewood Bangkok features four unique venues: Thai, Chinese, farm-to-table and a vinyl speakeasy.

facts.text: Lennon's is a speakeasy and vinyl bar with a 6,000-piece vinyl collection.
facts.excerpt: Feel nostalgic at Lennon's with an extensive 6,000 piece vinyl collection at your disposal.

facts.text: Lennon's serves signature cocktails inspired by music.
facts.excerpt: This retro speakeasy features signature cocktails inspired by your favorite tunes.

facts.text: Nan Bei, meaning South and North in Mandarin, serves Chinese cuisine in an art deco interior.
facts.excerpt: Nan Bei, meaning South and North respectively in Mandarin, presents an authentic Chinese dining experience amidst an imaginative art deco interior.

facts.text: Lakorn serves dishes from Thailand's four culinary regions alongside classic European dishes.
facts.excerpt: Savor the rich diversity of Thailand’s four culinary regions and classic European dishes.

facts.text: Lakorn has traditional Thai artistry and skyline views.
facts.excerpt: An enchanting setting adorned with traditional Thai artistry and sweeping skyline views.

facts.text: G&O is a farm-to-table cafe serving lunch and brunch with an emphasis on locally grown organic and natural ingredients.
facts.excerpt: For relaxed lunch and brunch dishes with an emphasis on organic and natural ingredients that are locally grown and sourced.
the café is ideal for guests who want to enjoy a casual dining experience overlooking the pool.

facts.text: The hotel has an indoor and outdoor saltwater lap pool located between the Fitness Studio and G&O.
facts.excerpt: A dramatic, 20-meter indoor and outdoor saltwater lap pool, conveniently located between the Fitness Studio and G&O.

facts.text: The hotel's Houses come with dedicated butler service, plunge pools and skyline views.
facts.excerpt: private sanctuaries with dedicated butler service, plunge pools, and stunning skyline views

facts.text: Guestrooms have modern interiors and panoramic city views.
facts.excerpt: Rosewood Bangkok’s guestrooms fuse elegantly modern interiors with panoramic views of the metropolis.

facts.text: Mama Bua leads a Thai cooking class at Lakorn exploring the cuisine of Thailand's Northern, Southern or Eastern regions.
facts.excerpt: Join Mama Bua for an immersive cooking class that combines hands-on experience with a unique exploration of Thai culture from the Northern, Southern, or Eastern regions of Thailand.

facts.text: A sommelier-guided Thai wine tasting at Lakorn features six wines from GranMonte Vineyards in Khao Yai.
facts.excerpt: Guided by an expert sommelier, uncork the essence of Thailand’s vineyards and taste six bold wines from GranMonte Vineyards, each capturing the unique character of Khao Yai’s terroir.

facts.text: Half-day tours of the Songwat community cover historic sites, art, local food and Thai desserts.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive half-day tours reveal Songwat's hidden gems, from historic sites and vibrant art to local food and Thai desserts.

facts.text: The Fitness Studio has Technogym equipment and views of the Bangkok skyline.
facts.excerpt: Bathed in natural light, the Fitness Studio offers a complete line-up of state-of-the-art Technogym equipment and views of the Bangkok skyline.

facts.text: The hotel has Sense, a Rosewood Spa.
facts.excerpt: Sense spa at Rosewood Bangkok offers a sanctuary of tranquility amidst bustling Bangkok, for rejuvenation, relaxation and the pursuit of well-being.

facts.text: Lennon's offers a cocktail masterclass covering two of its recipes, with non-alcoholic options available.
facts.excerpt: Tap into your inner mixologist with our expert bartenders to guide you through two exclusive recipes from Lennon’s, alongside delectable canapes. Non-alcoholic beverage class options are also available.

facts.text: The hotel has a hair salon and nail bar.
